name: pxpipe-context
description: Make pxpipe the default Responses provider path for all new Codex Local sessions, with an optional MCP for cold file references.

interface.shortDescription: Default new Codex sessions to pxpipe
interface.longDescription: Installs the primary whole-session provider proxy as the default path for all new Codex Local sessions and retains an optional, read-only MCP auxiliary for explicitly selected cold file references. It cannot retrofit the transport of a chat that is already running.
defaultPrompt: Enable pxpipe by default for every new Codex session
Verify that a Codex request was compressed
Optionally render approved cold reference files
